parts.text: I decide which drone flies along which way, and I sign off the flight before it leaves. I need help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. I don't know what exact information I enter or choose, what checks the service runs before I can save or sign off a flight, or what happens when two dispatchers try to book the same drone or site slot.
